### TUNE: Classic LE Raw - Classic LE with nothing working on the world: the wash and reflection gates are off, so room tails, explosions and your own shot's echo come through as the game mixed them.
### SELF GUN: High - Your gun eased back: a moderate front duck while you fire, about what Classic LE's Medium does, and a light cut on its copies on the object and top channels.
### HRIR: D1 KU100 - The default head, and where new profiles start.
### OUTPUT: Needs the Art Tune + (16ch) output.
